products.label: Cassini UVIS alpha Virginis occultation, 2006 day 285
products.process: Choose a kilometre bin of the occultation profile in proportion to its opacity, 1 - exp(-tau), times its radius; place a dot in Saturn's ring plane at that radius; repeat 4,000 times. The dot's longitude and its place inside the bin come from a seeded generator.
limitations: No ring particle has a measured position. Only the radial density of the dots is measured; each dot's longitude is drawn from a seeded generator.
The number of dots (4,000) and their size are display choices. The dots take the ring image's colour.
